decisions.reason: The existing message-143 FAQ Event already records Chainlink VRF, on-chain winner selection, and Basescan verification, so no additional MODIFY is needed.
The VRF provider and verification method belong to the separate winner-selection Requirement; the Big Block prize parameters remain unchanged.
The VRF provider and verification method belong to the separate winner-selection Requirement; the Small Block prize parameters remain unchanged.
Changing how winners are randomly selected does not change the Winners-page announcement channel.
The Chainlink VRF selection method does not alter the manual one-click prize claim flow.
Winner-selection randomness does not change the NFT mint number's role as the permanent referral code.
The VRF decision concerns prize winner selection and does not change badge milestones or on-chain badge recording.
The winner-selection provider is unrelated to the Transak fiat mint provider, conversion flow, or supported payment methods.
The VRF selection mechanism does not change referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, or timing.
The winner-selection implementation does not alter mint pricing or allocation of primary-sale revenue.
The VRF decision does not change which NFT entitlements, referral identity, badges, or expired-ticket state transfer on resale.
On-chain VRF execution does not require winner-selection details to be added to NFT metadata or change its existing counters, badges, or referral-code attribute.
